title: Tivoli Theatre, Brisbane

terrainReference.basis: Present ground at the reconstructed Albert Street public entrance. Historic grade is approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: Brisbane City Archives site history with surviving OpenStreetMap Albert Street, City Hall and Methodist church controls.

identities.name: Tivoli Theatre, Brisbane
identities.formerStreet: Albert Street, between Ann and Adelaide streets

mapIdentity.scope: Reconstructed 28.4 m by 50 m envelope northeast of the former Albert Street carriageway between Ann and Adelaide streets. The bearing follows the Albert Street continuation across modern King George Square. The story pin projected onto this line establishes the station of the entrance. Setback and depth are approximate.

note: The cleared 1918 street photograph establishes the height relationships, gabled rooftop theatre, tall wall bays, tripartite foyer window, terrace, and projecting cornice. The period description records removable upper side panels and a cornice projecting about six feet.
